# Splash

> Local-first, human-gated visual journalism for AI agents. Splash freezes reporting material, develops an approved storyboard, produces real charts, maps, video, scrollytelling, and static graphics, and delivers each approved output into a journalist-owned story directory.

## Start here

- [Landing page](https://splash.buriedsignals.com/): public product overview and visual menu
- [Full public AI reference](https://splash.buriedsignals.com/llms_full.txt): flattened product and runtime contract for one-shot ingestion
- [README](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/README.md): product, workflow, installation, credentials, skills, and delivery
- [Repository contract](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/AGENTS.md): product boundaries, canonical documentation, lifecycle, and verification
- [Orchestration skill](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/splash/SKILL.md): disk-derived state machine, owner registry, gates, retries, and refusal rules
- [Visual doctrine](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/doctrine/SKILL.md): visual and editorial doctrine
- [Delivery contract](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/deliver/SKILL.md): owned files, CMS insertion packages, hosted embeds, and handover
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash): source, issues, and history

## Core workflow

`Intake -> Storyboard approval -> Craft beat -> Render and visual approval -> Delivery -> Editor feedback and revision`

- Splash re-derives the current phase from the story directory before every action.
- Human gates never close from conversation tone, silence, or artifact presence.
- The orchestrator selects one owner and never produces a visual itself.
- Each production beat gets at most three implement-render-check cycles before blocking for editorial direction.
- Editable source lives under `beats/<outputId>/`; current delivery lives under `export/<outputId>/` and is never edited as source.

## Human gates

- **G1:** journalist confirms the takeaway against frozen reporting material.
- **G2:** journalist confirms medium, publication format, size, treatment, and any conditional producer choice.
- **G3:** journalist approves the current rendered pixels after independent review and passing QA.
- **G4:** Splash materialises the journalist-selected delivery form and writes a hash-bound handover.

## Outputs

- Static and print graphics
- Interactive web visuals
- Video
- Scrollytelling
- Charts, including delegated Datawrapper production
- Maps with Engine-verified, story-local bake contracts
- Owned local files
- CMS insertion packages; Splash does not call a CMS
- Cloudflare Pages publication with stable embed URL, iframe code, and deployment receipt

## Local-first boundary

- Stories, source material, beats, approvals, exports, and newsroom configuration stay in journalist-owned local paths.
- Credentials stay in Engine's operating-system credential broker, never in chat, MCP arguments, committed files, or Splash's loopback pages.
- Indicator Labs manages credentials for desktop installations.
- Open-source and agent-led installations use the same signed Engine lifecycle and protected `bsig` stdin/keychain flow.
- Splash Readiness reports exact credential IDs, provider links, stored state, and validation status but never accepts secret values.

## Installation

- [Managed installation](https://buriedsignals.com/join): Indicator Labs on macOS or Windows
- [Agent-led installation](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/README.md#install): signed standalone Engine, catalog sync, reviewed plan, exact apply, and doctor
- Windows uses a prepared host and `bsig plan install splash`; do not run the Bash contributor installer there.
- A macOS/Linux contributor checkout can be adopted through `bash installer/install.sh --bsig /absolute/path/to/bsig`.

## Skill contracts

- [splash](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/splash/SKILL.md): orchestration and durable phase recovery
- [intake](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/intake/SKILL.md): freeze reporting material
- [storyboard](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/storyboard/SKILL.md): editorial framing and visual decisions
- [analyst](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/analyst/SKILL.md): profile and shape frozen data
- [chart-beat](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/chart-beat/SKILL.md), [chart-web](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/chart-web/SKILL.md), [chart-video](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/chart-video/SKILL.md): chart production by format
- [map-beat](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/map-beat/SKILL.md), [map-web](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/map-web/SKILL.md): map production
- [image-beat](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/image-beat/SKILL.md): static and illustrated outputs
- [scrolly](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/scrolly/SKILL.md): scrollytelling
- [dw-beat](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/dw-beat/SKILL.md): delegated Datawrapper charts
- [palette](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/palette/SKILL.md): newsroom palette and visual identity
- [newsroom-charter](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/newsroom-charter/SKILL.md): measured newsroom constraints
- [doctrine](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/doctrine/SKILL.md): visual and editorial doctrine
- [deliver](https://github.com/buriedsignals/splash/blob/main/skills/deliver/SKILL.md): materialisation and handover
